keeps provider leases independent across provider identities

releases an acquired AI lease when newer authoritative work supersedes the run before reasoning
fences obsolete active provider output and releases its lease after the active request returns

productionLimits: Real Miniflare Workflow engine verifies configured exponential delays and recovery locally, not Cloudflare production scheduling or provider SLA.
Cancellation is cooperative at stage boundaries; an active external provider request holds its lease until it returns. Obsolete output is fenced and lease then released.
Latest-first recovery dispatches at most five queued items per sweep; queued outbox history is preserved during outage.
Two local Worker isolates share one D1 database; horizontal multi-host throughput, autoscaling and high-load latency remain unmeasured.
